g.text: server/claim-api.js sends the pasted text to a language model through the project's model gateway with a fixed
extraction prompt (company, claim wording, scope, year, tonnes). Each field must include a quote; the server keeps a
field only when the quote appears word for word in the pasted text (case and spacing ignored), a year appears in its
quote, and a tonnage's leading digits appear in its quote. The page then matches the company against the 94 reviewed
groups only, and all figures shown come from Netra's data. The EU note appears when the claim covers a product,
service or event and uses offset-based wording (neutral, zero, positive, compensated, offset, balanced).
